title: Riviera Rivals
description: A 15-minute strategy card game played on a 3D seaside resort. Draft rooms and amenities from a shared market, earn the best guest reviews and out-build the neighbouring resorts. Play solo against bots or online with a friend.
how_to_play: Played with the mouse. Start with Learn to play for a guided game, then choose Play now for a match against two bots, or share a room code with a friend. The rulebook is linked from the menu.
